limits: No OCR completeness guarantee; installed recognition is English and may miss Persian, tiny, obfuscated or fragmented text.
Current worktree and dated reachable original mirrors only; not external caches, unreachable refs, every image metadata field or every archive payload.
Raw text, crops, identifiers and exact original paths remain private outside Git.
Generic hostnames/new email addresses/prose passwords outside the identified-value list were not systematically classified in OCR; semantic review remains separate.
detection_scope: Identified literal values, including identified IPv6/email/password values
